chunks: The unbelievers said to their apostles: 'We shall drive you out of our land, or else you come back to our fold.' Their Lord then communicated to them: 'We shall annihilate these wicked people,'

key_terms.لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُمْ: We shall surely drive you out

ai.seo_question: What did God reveal to the prophets about the fate of the disbelievers who commanded them to leave or return to their religion?
ai.summary: In the context of the 'Day of the Messengers' (Yawm ar-Rusul), this verse highlights the ultimatum given by the disbelievers to their prophets: exile or apostasy. It underscores the divine promise of retribution against the oppressors, a theme central to Shia eschatology where the final victory of the righteous over their tyrannical adversaries is assured through God's decisive intervention.
